responsibility: This file implements the general-purpose numeric conversion engine between numbers and DynamicStrings for the mc-boot runtime. It converts signed and unsigned integer families across multiple bases, parses strings into integer and long-real values, formats floating-point values with width and fractional precision, and provides rounding helpers for significant figures and decimal places, relying on dtoa/ldtoa support and DynamicStrings allocation; it is the central numeric text-conversion subsystem beneath FpuIO and FormatStrings.
same_name_distinction: This .cc file is the implementation side of the GStringConvert pair, containing the full numeric parsing/formatting engine and rounding helpers built on DynamicStrings, dtoa, and ldtoa support; gcc/m2/mc-boot/GStringConvert.h is only the large declaration surface for that API.
